summary: First iteration Lumen headlight cleaning booking app. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed covering GET slots, admin login OK/401, create/delete slot, booking flow (create + duplicate 400 + phone lookup + reject-frees-slot), admin bookings list. Frontend (mobile 375x667): home renders slots grouped by date with amber theme + LUMEN hero, tapping slot opens booking form (name, phone, brand+model pickers, notes, submit), admin route shows password wall, correct password reveals dashboard with Zahtevi/Termini tabs, filter chips, and empty state.

issues: React Native web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow' (non-blocking, from Expo web renderer)

critical_code_review_comments: Admin password stored in AsyncStorage in plaintext + sent via header on every request — acceptable for owner-only panel but consider a short-lived token if scope grows.
PATCH /api/admin/bookings sets status without checking prior state — rejecting an already-rejected booking will still hit db.slots.update_one (harmless idempotent, but could log).
seed_data_creation: Tests create + clean up ephemeral slots/bookings (TEST_ prefix on names/phones). Booking flow test consumes one seeded slot and rejects it to restore is_booked=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Admin route is /admin (Expo Router tab). All UI copy Serbian. Booking submit requires brand then model picker (model picker disabled until brand selected).
